instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the KiCad graphical user interface (Project Manager, Schematic Editor, and PCB Editor). Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run kicad-cli, pcbnew in batch mode, Python, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only KiCad native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Enclosure Compatibility with Hammond 1455 The file board.kicad_pcb is a 150x100 mm board with several placed components. The file /home/user/Desktop/enclosure.yaml specifies the Hammond 1455C1201 internal PCB slot dimensions and keep-in clearance. Shrink the board outline to fit within the enclosure slot dimensions. Reposition any component whose center is within the keep-in distance of the new board edge. Requirements: 1. Board width <= internal_slot_w_mm (from /home/user/Desktop/enclosure.yaml). 2. Board height <= internal_slot_h_mm (from /home/user/Desktop/enclosure.yaml). 3. Every component center is >= edge_keep_in_mm from all board edges. 4. All original component references (U1, U2, R1, R2) must still be present. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.
